question: The 7th Commonwealth youth games held in:
solution:
The correct answer is **__2023__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** 7th Commonwealth Youth Games** took place on the **Islands of Trinidad and Tobago **between 4-11 August 2023. 900+ athletes and para-athletes between the ages of 14 to 18 will participate in seven sports managed by 500+ officials.
 
• The **Commonwealth Youth Games** is an immense springboard for the stars and leaders of tomorrow, contributing to the development of youth sports throughout the Commonwealth. The Games have traditionally taken place every 4 years with the first event being hosted in Edinburgh, Scotland in 2000.
 
• **Trinidad and Tobago** were initially awarded the 2021 Commonwealth Youth Games in June 2019, but the Games were postponed due to the impact of the pandemic on the international sports calendar.
 
• The **sports will take place across Trinidad and Tobago**, bringing a diverse perspective of the twin island country to the nations of the Commonwealth, as well as showcasing a festival of the country’s activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonwealth Youth Games**:

 
 
• The Commonwealth Youth Programme has been supporting member countries with youth development work for 50 years.
 
• In Commonwealth member countries, 2023 is the Year of Youth.
